meta.title: Western Ghats Birding & Wildlife Tours | Wildora Expeditions
meta.description: Small-group birding and wildlife tours in India's Western Ghats, led by doctorate-holding naturalists: endemic birds, Nilgiri tahr, lion-tailed macaques.
meta.ogDescription: Small-group, naturalist-led journeys into the rainforests, shola grasslands and tiger country of South India.

footer.tagline: Small-group nature journeys in the Western Ghats and beyond, guided by doctorate-holding naturalists. Walk slowly, look closely, travel lightly.
